quote.text: Give me by all means the shorter and nobler life, instead of one that is longer but of less account!
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace the noble quality of parenting by investing in meaningful, quality interactions rather than simply spending time; strive for moments that truly shape character.
    • Remember that a brief period marked by intentional guidance and love can outweigh a prolonged time of distracted, less purposeful engagement with your children.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, seek to act decisively and honorably; transforming short, impactful initiatives into legacies of virtue rather than merely extending your tenure for its own sake.
    • Focus on the substance of your contributions, ensuring that every decision resonates with integrity and purpose, much like a noble life is preferred over lengthy but trivial existence.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, prioritize creating solutions that offer profound value—even if the process is swift—as quality trumps quantity in the marketplace.
    • Channel your efforts into projects that embody core principles and meaningful impact, ensuring that each product stands as a testament to a focused, noble vision.
